title: Disappointing
text: Disappointing. It is disappointing - it does not get very hot. I have to set it for 400 degrees just to grill a hamburger. I have had other Foreman grills that worked much better.

product_metadata.title: George Foreman GRP99BLK 100-Square-Inch Nonstick Countertop Grill, Black
features: Indoor grill with 100-square-inch cooking surface and George Tough triple nonstick coating
Patented sloped design channels grease away from food and into drip tray
Control panel with LED display, variable temperature control, and easy-to-read digital timer
Embedded heating elements; cool-touch handles; dishwasher-safe parts
description: Add a side of technology to your next meal. We’re talking about the digital controls on the 6-serving removable plate George Foreman grill and panini. The push-button controls for power, time, and temperature, give you fast, precise cooking results. You can make meats, veggies, sandwiches, or any other food you feel like grilling. And you know cleanup is no sweat with the dishwasher-safe, nonstick grill plates. George Foreman grills make dinner easy.
